title: Soy Isoflavone Tablets: Effects on Sleep, Quality of Life, Symptoms and Cognitive Function in Menopausal Women
brief_summary: The study was done to elucidate relationships between midlife women's self-reported hot flashes, neuropsychological symptoms, cognitive performance or sleep.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* At least 5 hot flash episodes and/or night sweats per 24 hours

Exclusion Criteria:

* Body mass index (BMI) more than 34 kg/m2
* Hypertension
* Shift work
* Psychiatric or medical conditions that would affect outcome measures
* More than 4 caffeine drinks per day
* More than 10 cigarettes per day
* More than than 7 alcohol drinks per week
